articles.title: Russia’s parliament passes crypto market law with $3,800 annual cap for retail investors
articles.snippet: While citizens still cannot use Bitcoin to buy groceries, the Kremlin is officially letting companies use digital tokens to bypass sanctions and other global trade hurdles.

articles.title: MoneyGram's CEO says blockchain works best when customers don't know it's there
articles.snippet: In an interview with CoinDesk, MoneyGram CEO Anthony Soohoo said that their blockchain strategy has evolved from early experimentation into a broader effort to modernize the company's global payments infrastructure.

articles.title: Brazil’s securities regulator sets up task force with 60-day deadline for tokenization proposal
articles.snippet: The framework will address critical issues like official ownership records, private key custody, transaction reversibility and system liability.

articles.title: BIS warns stablecoins could weaken capital controls in emerging markets
articles.snippet: Researchers found dollar-backed stablecoins are less affected by capital controls than traditional bank deposits, raising new questions about monetary sovereignty in emerging markets.

articles.title: Bitcoin nears seven-week high as stocks ignore Iran strikes, Trump 10% tariff plans
articles.snippet: Bitcoin and crypto joined US stocks in brushing off US-Iran war escalation and the threat of fresh trade tariffs before the end of the month.
